Looking for a sourcing agent: print on demand, delivery to the EU

EU online shop selling personalized pet-themed gifts and home decor, with customers in France and Belgium.

We are looking for a reliable agent to handle one product to start with. We have already identified and quality-tested a reference product (from a well-known Chinese marketplace). You can work with that supplier, or propose an alternative supplier if the quality is equivalent.

What we need:

- Liaise with the factory and launch production for each order

- Print on demand: single quantities, each piece with a customized printed design (we supply the files)

- Handle customs and import into the EU (FR, BE or DE) under our IOSS number

- A clear all-in price per piece, delivered

We want a long-term partner: if this works well, we will collaborate with more products.

If you can do this, especially the IOSS part, please comment or send a DM.
